## WF1 — Nightly Generator (logic complete)
Runs at 06:00 in TZ America/New_York. Also exposes the `fb-generate-now` webhook (verify the `x-webhook-secret: __N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET__` header — n8n redacts Authorization) that the Dashboard 'Generate Now' button calls with { scheduled_date }.

Pipeline: nightly path now tops up the buffer — it follows the earliest planned fb_content_plan slot within GENERATION_BUFFER_DAYS (using that slot's pillar/archetype/subtopic and marking it 'generated'), falling back to the first uncovered date in a 5-day horizon + LRU subtopic when no plan exists; on-demand path uses the body's scheduled_date + LRU subtopic. Then: least-recently-used active subtopic (its pillar) → message bank + prompts → archetype → Anthropic generator → tolerant JSON parse → image prompt → Generate Image (OpenAI gpt-image-1, swappable) → decode → PUT upload to the PUBLIC fb-images bucket → set public image_url → insert fb_posts (copy_status/image_status='pending') → bump subtopic last_used_at/times_used → GroupMe.

NOTE (generator v2 / canon fix): the active `generator` prompt now carries Strategist-brief placeholders. Build Generator Prompt fills image-only / no-brief defaults for them and strips any leftover {{...}} token, so the canon fix is safe before the Strategist pass exists. When the Strategist pass lands, replace those defaults + the strip with the real approved-brief values.

Replace `YOUR_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` and `__...__` placeholders with credentials/values on import. Keep `active:false` in the committed copy.
